data.title: Barcelona Predicted Lineup vs. Alaves: Flick Focuses on Rotation After Tough Week
data.content:
It has been a demanding start to the season for the back-to-back champions, who had been perfect across the board in a record-breaking manner before last week’s blip. Injuries are starting the mount, but Flick has enough in his reserve to cope, especially against a Deportivo Alavés side that’s winless on nine visits to Barcelona and is without a win since Sept. 6.

Here’s how Barcelona could line up against Alavés on Saturday.

Barcelona Predicted Lineup vs. Alavés (4-2-3-1) [...] GK: Joan García—Flick is likely to opt for widespread changes, given Barça’s upcoming fixtures, but García is less in need of respite than many of the outfielders.

RB: João Cancelo—Unless the manager turns to La Masia, Cancelo will likely have to continue at right back in Xavi Espart’s absence.

CB: Pau Cubarsí—Injuries mean the hosts are short at center back, so Cubarsí, who harshly missed out on the Kopa Trophy at the Ballon d’Or ceremony, will have to keep his spot. [...] Pick Your Barcelona XI!

CM: Frenkie de Jong—De Jong’s return from a knee injury sustained at the World Cup will be welcomed. The Dutchman settled in nicely last week, and could wear the captain’s armband at Camp Nou.

RW: Lamine Yamal—Yamal’s quest for the 2027 Ballon d’Or has already begun, and the young Spaniard will be in a vengeful mood after missing out on Monday evening.
